notes.title: If you have technical issues
notes.content:
Please note that we cannot offer official technical support on this board, except for posting the latest patch notes.

[h1]But your games and my computer don’t work as a team! Where can I get help?[/h1]
We do offer technical support. Just not in forums. Please contact our colleagues from the support via mail using [url=mailto:support@daedalic.de] support@daedalic.de[/url]. However, feel free and use this forum (or our [url=http://forum.daedalic.de/index.php]official forum[/url]) to address your technical problem. We are certain that many players of our games are able to help you out with certain problems.  

[h1]What can I do to speed up the support process?[/h1]
In order to speed up the process our support needs information of your running system and the game (version) you are playing. So [url=http://forum.daedalic.de/viewtopic.php?f=145&t=1530]please read before reporting technical issues to us[/url].

Thank you very much for your ongoing support!


Best regards,
your Daedalic Entertainment Community Team
